name: NULL CARTOGRAPHY SIGNAL
description: A newer-generation pirate network that operates exclusively in short-burst transmissions, distributing content in compressed packets across the mesh rather than continuous broadcast streams. Null Cartography Signal specializes in investigative content, leaked corporate documents presented as narrative journalism, and first-person testimony feeds from individuals inside corponation territories who cannot speak openly through licensed channels. Each transmission is self-contained and encrypted with a different key distributed through physical dead drops.
cultural_impact: Pioneered the burst-packet distribution model that made pirate broadcasting significantly harder to jam, a technical innovation that spread to numerous other underground networks within two years.
story_hooks: The physical dead drop system for Null Cartography Signal's encryption keys has been infiltrated — someone is collecting keys without distributing them, meaning recent transmissions may have been intercepted.
A corporate security contractor hired to shut down Null Cartography Signal has instead become one of its sources, feeding verified internal documents through the same channels she was paid to close.

The network broadcasts a testimony feed from someone claiming to be a current Spire resident — and the details they provide about Tier 5 internal politics are specific enough to be credible and dangerous.
